summary: Tested Opening Balance Sheet ACCOUNT CLEAR '+' party-wise breakdown (backend + UI + print + Excel). Setup: SETTLE TEST PARTY settled 20-06 (leftover 60) and QA CLEAR PARTY B settled 22-06 (leftover 50). Backend: rows carry id, settle_account_id returned, ACCOUNT CLEAR = 110 Dr, account-clear?date_to breakdown sums to the head (5/5 pass, 1 skipped: no closed FY). UI: exactly one toggle (ob-clear-toggle) on ACCOUNT CLEAR row; no ob-clear-breakdown before click; '+' -> '−' shows breakdown as the row's next sibling with sub-rows '↳ SETTLE TEST PARTY · cleared upto 20-06-2026' 60.00 DR and '↳ QA CLEAR PARTY B · cleared upto 22-06-2026' 50.00 DR (60 first); '−' hides it. Group TOTAL (OTHER / UNGROUPED 110.00), grand DR/CR, ledger count (349), DIFFERENCE are identical before/after expand/collapse. Print media: toggle display:none, breakdown visible when expanded, absent when collapsed. Excel downloads in both states; expanded sheet has the 2 '↳' rows, collapsed doesn't. As-on 2026-06-19: ACCOUNT CLEAR row gone, no JS errors. Found one race bug: the sheet can show stale data for a different date than the As-on input.

ui_bugs.component: OpeningBalance.jsx useEffects (opening-balances fetch + account-clear breakdown fetch)
ui_bugs.issue: Race condition / stale response: no cancel/ignore guard. Reproduced: open /opening-balance (default as_on = today 2026-10-19, slow ~349 ledgers), then right away set As-on to 2026-06-30. URL and input show 2026-06-30, but the sheet header says 'AS ON 19-10-2026' because the older today-request came back last and overwrote the data. The Excel filename/print header then use the wrong date too. The breakdown effect has the same problem (it can show account-clear for a different date_to than the data).

action_items: OpeningBalance.jsx: in both fetch effects add `let alive = true; ... .then(r => alive && setX(...)); return () => { alive = false; }` (or AbortController) so a stale as_on response can't overwrite the newer one.

Optional: Account Clear sub-rows come only from journal lines. If ACCOUNT CLEAR ever has an opening balance or a rokad posting, the sub-rows won't add up to the head. Consider adding a 'Opening / other' sub-row for the difference.
critical_code_review_comments: Stale-response race in OpeningBalance.jsx effects (see ui_bugs).

In FY carry-forward mode (fy_id), the breakdown uses /reports/account-clear?date_to=new_fy_start. That covers all past journals and may not match the carried-forward snapshot balance. Not tested: there is no closed FY.
account-clear rows with several non-clear lines use others[0].account_id as party_id, so a multi-party manual journal goes under the first party only.
seed_data_creation: Created temporarily and then cleaned up: 2 settle rokad entries + party QA CLEAR PARTY B. SETTLE TEST PARTY is back to 1000 Dr; ACCOUNT CLEAR is kept.
